bounded_checks.findings: Corrections, no sequence change. (1) The manual contains no DNB, rolling-circle, polymerase or sequencing-primer text: its endpoint is the bead-cleaned, Qubit-QC'd ssCir library. Added the missing bead-cleanup step and purified-ssCir product, and a graph-owned notice that the drawn nanoball steps come from the DNBSEQ platform architecture, not this kit; the phi29 input is now labelled a DNB-preparation reagent outside the kit. (2) 'linear-DNA exonuclease' replaced by the kit's actual 'Digestion Enzyme' in Digestion Buffer with its volumes/conditions, marked inferred because identity and activity are undisclosed. (3) Denaturation stated exactly (95 °C, 3 min, 1 pmol in 48 µL TE) instead of 'heat or alkaline'. (4) The complementary strand was typed as discarded waste; the manual does not say which strand is circularized, so it is now a Disposition.UNRESOLVED terminal. (5) Added the input restriction notice (Duplex UMI / UDB / MGI Dual-barcode standard product only, not single-barcode; 1 pmol recommended, 0.5 pmol minimum) and the exact splint/ligase volumes and 37 °C 30 min conditions. Caveat and note rewritten accordingly.
